raw_source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
translation: 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。
symbol_source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.

raw_source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
translation: 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。
symbol_source: Now, place your hands upon mine.

raw_source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
translation: 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……
symbol_source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...

raw_source: Having touched the prison of Traeh, the interloper was no longer themself.
translation: 触碰到特蕾的囚牢之后，那名闯入者便不再是从前的自己。
symbol_source: Having touched the prison of Traeh, the interloper was no longer themself.

raw_source: Enough dark psychic power had passed in that one moment of contact
translation: 就在接触的那一刻，已有足够多的黑暗灵能传递了过去，
symbol_source: Enough dark psychic power had passed in that one moment of contact

raw_source: that Traeh had a willing minion to send out into the wild.
translation: 特蕾也就有了一个甘愿效命的爪牙，可被差往荒野。
symbol_source: that Traeh had a willing minion to send out into the wild.

raw_source: One by one, this twisted agent rounded up the remaining council members
translation: 这名被扭曲的代理人，把理事会余下的成员一个一个捉走，
symbol_source: One by one, this twisted agent rounded up the remaining council members

raw_source: ensuring that the powers that kept Traeh imprisoned weakened more each day.
translation: 以此确保囚禁特蕾的力量一天天地衰弱下去。
symbol_source: ensuring that the powers that kept Traeh imprisoned weakened more each day.

raw_source: Even if the wise council members were intent on psychically detaining Traeh
translation: 即便睿智的议会成员决意以心灵之力拘禁特蕾，
symbol_source: Even if the wise council members were intent on psychically detaining Traeh

raw_source: after being subjugated to experiment after dark experiment...
translation: 在接连遭受一场又一场黑暗实验的摆布之后……
symbol_source: after being subjugated to experiment after dark experiment...

raw_source: ...not even the wisest of Fenfen minds could wage battles on that many fronts.
translation: ……即便是Fenfen中最智慧的头脑，也无法在如此众多的战线上同时作战。
symbol_source: ...not even the wisest of Fenfen minds could wage battles on that many fronts.

raw_source: Without the powers of the Fenfen council to hold Traeh prisoner
translation: 一旦没有了Fenfen理事会的力量来囚禁特蕾，
symbol_source: Without the powers of the Fenfen council to hold Traeh prisoner

raw_source: it's only a matter of time before she's able to break free and wage war once more.
translation: 她破囚而出、再度开战，便只是时间问题。
symbol_source: it's only a matter of time before she's able to break free and wage war once more.

raw_source: And this time, there will be no resistance against her evil power.
translation: 而到了那时，将再没有任何力量能够抵挡她的邪恶之力。
symbol_source: And this time, there will be no resistance against her evil power.

raw_source: The only thing that keeps this evil Queen from conquering all of Tutone
translation: 唯一让这邪恶女王尚未征服整个图托恩的，
symbol_source: The only thing that keeps this evil Queen from conquering all of Tutone

raw_source: is her desire to gain enough strength to transfer into a new host body.
translation: 是她想要积蓄足够的力量，转移到一个新的宿主躯体之中。
symbol_source: is her desire to gain enough strength to transfer into a new host body.

raw_source: Perhaps, then, it is another twist of Fate that sent you to this planet
translation: 那么，也许又是命运的一次转折，把你送到了这颗星球，
symbol_source: Perhaps, then, it is another twist of Fate that sent you to this planet

raw_source: and had you arrive so near to where all this calamitous action took place.
translation: 并且让你来到距离这场灾难发生之地如此之近的地方。
symbol_source: and had you arrive so near to where all this calamitous action took place.

raw_source: Will you be an even more powerful host for Traeh, Queen of Darkness?
translation: 你会成为黑暗女王特蕾更加强大的宿主吗？
symbol_source: Will you be an even more powerful host for Traeh, Queen of Darkness?

raw_source: Or will you be the saviour of the Fenfen, a beacon of courage and hope...?
translation: 还是说，你会成为Fenfen的救主，一座勇气与希望的灯塔……？
symbol_source: Or will you be the saviour of the Fenfen, a beacon of courage and hope...?

raw_source: ...Only you can decide, hero.
translation: ……只有你能决定，英雄。
symbol_source: ...Only you can decide, hero.

raw_source: Whew! That was a pretty decent work out!
translation: 呼！这运动量还真够劲！

raw_source: Guess you were expecting a lesser agent again, huh?
translation: 看来你以为这次又是个不入流的特工，嗯？

raw_source: If you're not willing to negotiate, I *am* prepared to defend myself.
translation: 要是你不肯谈，我*也*已经做好自卫的准备了。

raw_source: But first, looks like you've got some stolen cosmo-gear...
translation: 不过先等等，看来你这里有偷来的宇宙装备……

raw_source: Lookee what we have here... my lighttazer!
translation: 瞧瞧，这是什么……我的光刃电击器！

raw_source: Those darn little twerps must've squirrelled it away here.
translation: 肯定是那几个讨厌的小混蛋把它藏在这儿了。

raw_source: Hey, waitasec... This isn't mine! This looks like one that...
translation: 哎，等等……这不是我的！看着像是……

raw_source: ...some dumb little newbie would've dropped!
translation: ……某个蠢新手才会弄丢的东西！

raw_source: Man oh man, I'd hate to be the trainee that dropped their first Lighttazer!
translation: 天哪，弄丢第一把光电击枪的实习生可惨了！

raw_source: That's the kinda thing that gets you dragged in front of HR!
translation: 这种事可是会被人事部叫去训话的！

raw_source: Thankfully, I'm far too elite to ever do something like that!
translation: 幸好我这种精英，绝不会干那种事！

raw_source: I just, uhh...
translation: 我只是，呃……

raw_source: ...left mine back at the ship? I think?
translation: ……把我的落在船上了？大概吧？

raw_source: Anyways! No time to be concerned about such minor details.
translation: 总之！没空纠结这些小细节了。

raw_source: Tutone's got an eco-crisis to resolve, and I've got a little bro to find!
translation: 图托恩的生态危机等着解决，我还得找到弟弟！

raw_source: Well well, looks like you're awake.
translation: 哟，看来你醒了。

raw_source: I'm not here to hurt you, big guy. I just want a little information.
translation: 我不是来伤害你的，大块头。我只是想打听点消息。

raw_source: First things first, have you seen any other cosmo-agents down in this-
translation: 先说正事，你有没有在这下面见过其他宇宙特工——

raw_source: Eeeek!!
translation: 呀啊！！

raw_source: Heeey! What are you freaking out about? I just wanted to talk!
translation: 喂——！你慌什么？我只是想聊聊！

raw_source: Gah!! You get back here! I'm not done with you yet!
translation: 啊！！给我回来！我还没跟你说完呢！

raw_source: Well now, you tried to set up an ambush didn't you? See what happens?
translation: 瞧瞧，你刚才是想设埋伏，对不对？这下知道后果了吧？

raw_source: Didn't mean to bonk you so hard... but if it's a fight you want, I'll bring it!
translation: 我也没想敲你那么重……不过你要想打，我就奉陪！

raw_source: I didn't become one of the most elite agents with sloppy tazer-play!
translation: 我能成为最精锐的特工之一，可不是靠乱挥电击器！

raw_source: When I graduated at only 22 years old, with honors, it was big news!
translation: 才22岁就以优异成绩毕业，我当时可上了大新闻！

raw_source: I was the face of the PPPC's recruitment campaign and everything.
translation: 我还当过PPPC招募宣传的代言人呢。

raw_source: Being the youngest agent to ever see active duty was craaaaazy intense.
translation: 作为史上最年轻的实战特工，压力简直大到爆。

raw_source: ...even if my little brother managed to take that record from me...
translation: ……虽然最年轻的纪录后来被我弟弟抢走了……

raw_source: But no matter! That doesn't diminish my accomplishments one bit.
translation: 不过无所谓！这丝毫不损我的功绩。

raw_source: And no belligerent lizard is gonna stop me from saving this planet!
translation: 好斗的蜥蜴可别想阻止我拯救这颗星球！

raw_source: So, ready to start talking yet? I'm a Cosmobreeder, and I'm here to help!
translation: 怎么样，现在肯说话了吗？我是宇宙育种者，是来帮忙的！

raw_source: We're the galaxy-wide experts in fauna management.
translation: 我们是全银河动物管理方面的专家。

raw_source: Our noble mission: to restore and nurture even the most ruined planets!
translation: 我们崇高的使命，就是让再破败的星球也能恢复生机、茁壮成长！

raw_source: No bio-wasteland or terra-forming disaster is too far gone...
translation: 不管是生态荒原，还是星球改造灾难，都还有救……

raw_source: When you see the miracles that we can work, I'm sure you'll regret fighting!
translation: 等你见识到我们创造的奇迹，一定会后悔跟我打架！

raw_source: Even the most violent species eventually come to love their wise...
translation: 就算是最凶暴的物种，最终也会爱上他们睿智的……

raw_source: ...heroic, shepherding Cosmobreeders!
translation: ……英勇的、悉心照料他们的宇宙育种者！

raw_source: W-woah big guy! I was just explaining how I'm super helpful!
translation: 哇、哇哦，大块头！我只是在解释我有多能帮上忙！

raw_source: You don't have to go scrambling off!
translation: 用不着这么慌慌张张地跑掉吧！

raw_source: Aaaand you definitely didn't have to take the door out on your way, ow!
translation: 还有，你走的时候真没必要连门都拆了，哎哟！

raw_source: You gotta be careful with those, you know. They're often load bearing!
translation: 那些可得当心点，知道吗？经常都是承重的！

raw_source: Not even us agents will take out a door frame, because you run the risk of-
translation: 连我们特工都不拆门框，因为一不小心就——

raw_source: -having the ceiling collapse on ya! Darn it!
translation: ——被塌下来的天花板砸！可恶！

raw_source: Well I was hoping to dig around for more of my gear, but I guess I'll...
translation: 本想再翻翻，找些自己的装备，可看来我得……

raw_source: ...wait a sec, what's that falling from up there...?
translation: ……等下，上头掉下来的是什么……？

raw_source: No way... I can't believe my luck!
translation: 不会吧……我的运气也太好了！

raw_source: I was just thinking about how useful a hyper bracer would be right about now!
translation: 我刚还在想，这会儿要是有个超能护腕可就太有用了！

raw_source: I'll be able to slide my way out of here in no time, heh!
translation: 我马上就能一路滑出这地方啦，嘿！

raw_source: ...just let me strap this bracer on...
translation: ……先让我把这只护腕戴上……

raw_source: ...and away we go!
translation: ……出发喽！

raw_source: Heh! Heh! Heh!
translation: 嘿！嘿！嘿！

raw_source: Some of you little folks have some proper fight in you... Heh!
translation: 你们这些小个子里，有几个还挺能打……嘿！

raw_source: I'd almost thought that the lot of you were merely an annoyance
translation: 我差点以为，你们这些小东西只配惹人烦

raw_source: but here's one that actually manged to hit me. Heh!
translation: 没想到还真有个能打中我的。呵！

raw_source: What's next, one of you coming along and knocking me down to-
translation: 接下来呢，你们还想来一个把我也撞——

raw_source: Give me a break! I just got through smacking you up and down this cavern!
translation: 饶了我吧！刚才我才揍得你满洞窟乱窜！

raw_source: I'm Cosmobreeder Yiffany, the best of the best!
translation: 我是宇宙育种者伊法妮，精英中的精英！

raw_source: For your information, I haven't shown you a fraction of my power!
translation: 告诉你，我连一丁点真本事都还没使出来！

raw_source: What-!? How can you still move this fast after taking so many tazer blows?!
translation: 什、什么！？挨了那么多下电击，你怎么还这么快？！

raw_source: Power...? My little yellow furred companion? You wish to speak of power?
translation: 力量……？黄毛小伙伴，你想谈力量？

raw_source: Perhaps you'd like a lesson in just such a topic as "power"
translation: 或许，你想上一堂关于“力量”的课

raw_source: and then you can recite it to me, no?
translation: 再由你背给我听，如何？

raw_source: G-gonna stand up... again... any... any minute now...
translation: 我、我马上……就又能……站起来了……

raw_source: ...s-stand up and leave you be... I... mean... owch...
translation: ……站、站起来就不打扰你了……我……是说……好疼……

raw_source: Here, spunky yellow girl. Take your leave of my domain.
translation: 好吧，黄毛野丫头，离开我的领地吧。

raw_source: And while you're at it, take this garbage that a fellow small fighter left
translation: 顺便，把另一个小个子战士留下的垃圾也带走，

raw_source: after I had given him an even rougher lesson than yours.
translation: 那次我给他的教训，比给你的还狠。

raw_source: With shoes in hand, Yiffany scrambles out as the Redbull drops deeper into the mines
translation: 伊法妮拿着靴子爬出去，红牛则深入矿井

raw_source: his glowing red mane fading eerily into the dark...
translation: 他泛着红光的鬃毛诡异地隐入黑暗……

raw_source: Hmf, getting a bit tired of this planet, and all you immortal beings on it...
translation: 哼，有点受够这颗星球，还有你们这些住在上面的不朽生灵了……

raw_source: No matter how many hits you take, you're still fresh as when I walked in here!
translation: 不管挨了多少下，你还是跟我刚进来时一样精神！

raw_source: Lemme guess, you're one of those immortal elves?
translation: 让我猜猜，你也是那些不朽精灵中的一员？

raw_source: Correct, young lady. I am Enelye, the Immortal High Lady of the Tutone Elves.
translation: 没错，年轻的女士。我是恩内莉，图托恩精灵的不朽至高女领主。

raw_source: I must commend your most respectable performance in the art of combat
translation: 你在战斗技艺上的表现令人肃然起敬，我必须予以赞扬，

raw_source: it was a highly enjoyable act to watch, even for one as old as I.
translation: 即便对我这样年长的人而言，观赏这场表演也十分愉快。

raw_source: It was so enjoyable, that I believe you are due for a reward.
translation: 实在是太令人愉快了，我想你理应得到一份奖励。

raw_source: So please, sit back and relax while I...
translation: 所以，请坐好，放松下来，让我……

raw_source: ...reward... you suitably...
translation: ……好好地……奖励你……

raw_source: Woah! W-wait a minute, L-lady Enelye...! I'm here to *save* your-
translation: 哇！等、等一下，女、女领主恩内莉……！我是来*拯救*你的——

raw_source: Eeeek!
translation: 呀啊！

raw_source: ...really!? I can do this myself!
translation: ……不是吧！？我自己能来！

raw_source: Wa-hey! Actually, I'm usually not a dress-girl... but this feels really nice!
translation: 哇哦！其实我平时不怎么穿裙子……不过这感觉真不错！

raw_source: ...but next time, your highness?
translation: ……不过下次，殿下？

raw_source: I'll dress myself!
translation: 我自己穿衣服！

raw_source: Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.
translation: 汝虽未受操练，这一战倒也打得不赖。
symbol_source: Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.

raw_source: Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.
translation: 敢问阁下尊姓大名，好让吾致以敬意。
symbol_source: Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.

raw_source: ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...
translation: ……啊，然汝故土之人不通吾语……
symbol_source: ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...

raw_source: What gives?! All the punishment I'm dishing out...
translation: 搞什么？！我下了这么多狠手……

raw_source: ...only seems to make you stronger?! What ARE you?!
translation: ……反倒只让你越来越强？！你到底是什么东西？！

raw_source: I need not speaketh your crude tongue in order to understand your crude desire
translation: 无需通晓汝之粗鄙言语，吾亦明了汝之粗鄙欲求。
symbol_source: I need not speaketh your crude tongue in order to understand your crude desire

raw_source: So struggle not as I placeth a most useful trinket upon thee.
translation: 故而莫要挣扎，待吾为汝戴上这实用的小饰物。
symbol_source: So struggle not as I placeth a most useful trinket upon thee.

raw_source: No way! You can't just snap a collar on me like I'm some... some kind of pet!
translation: 不行！不能就这么给我扣上项圈，当我是……是什么宠物！

raw_source: Me... and the other Cosmobreeders! We'll make you regret this!
translation: 我……还有其他宇宙育种者，会让你后悔的！

raw_source: And how shalt thou do that, fairest knight?
translation: 最美的骑士啊，汝打算如何做到？

raw_source: Mine powers are ancient and forgotten, and thou are but a pup lost in the dark.
translation: 吾之力量古老且已被遗忘，汝不过是暗夜迷途的幼犬。

raw_source: Prayeth that I overlook your ill mannered outburst, as the generous host I am.
translation: 祈求吾以宽宏主人之身，不计较汝方才的无礼罢。

raw_source: Now taketh this necklace so that you may understand others of this land
translation: 且收下这项链，好让汝听懂此地众人的话语

raw_source: ...and spareth them from your ill manners...eh heh heh heh...
translation: ……也免得汝再对他们无礼……呵呵呵呵……

raw_source: And with a gutteral laugh, the demonic form faded back into the darkest darks
translation: 随着一阵低沉的笑声，那恶魔身影退回最深的黑暗，

raw_source: leaving nought but a scared pup in his wake...
translation: 只留下一只吓坏的小狗……

raw_source: Ugh! What is it with you little pipsqueaks?
translation: 呃！你们这些小不点到底是怎么回事？

raw_source: First you pillage my belongings, then you try to attack me?
translation: 先是洗劫我的东西，接着又想来攻击我？

raw_source: Well, you've got another thing coming, you little bra-
translation: 好啊，你们可想错了，你这个小混-

raw_source: -wait a minute...!
translation: -等一下……！

raw_source: Is that really...
translation: 那真的是……

raw_source: ...YES, it is!!
translation: ……没错，就是它！！

raw_source: It's my standard issue Cosmohelm! I've been looking for this since I landed!
translation: 这就是我的标配Cosmohelm！我一落地就在找它！

raw_source: That brat must have squirrelled it away down here!
translation: 一定是那个小鬼把它偷偷藏到这下面来了！

raw_source: This is perfect! If I can find my whole suit, I'll be able to go space-walking!
translation: 太完美了！如果我能找齐整套装备，就能去太空漫步了！

raw_source: ...or at least traverse some low oxygen areas...
translation: ……或者至少能穿行于一些低氧区域……

raw_source: Now... Yiffai, you're gonna have to wake up for me!
translation: 现在……伊法伊，你一定要醒过来啊！

raw_source: If you're not still in there... I don't, I don't know what I'd do!!
translation: 要是你已经不在里面了……我不，我不知道该怎么办！！

raw_source: Uuhn... big sis... I remember you...
translation: 唔……姐姐……我记得你……

raw_source: In fact, getting knocked to the darn ground like this again...
translation: 说真的，又像这样被狠狠打倒在地……

raw_source: ...is makin' me remember you even more.
translation: ……反而让我更想起你了。

raw_source: Like when we used to tussle... heh, you never did gimme a break...
translation: 就像以前我们打闹的时候……嘿，你可从来没让过我……

raw_source: ...my tough big sis, who taught me everything... and always looked out for me...
translation: ……我那厉害的姐姐，什么都教给了我……也一直护着我……

raw_source: Yiffai... y-you're back!
translation: 伊法伊……你、你回来了！

raw_source: I can't believe it... I thought... I thought I might have to...
translation: 真不敢相信……我以为……我以为自己可能不得不……

raw_source: But now you're safe again!
translation: 不过现在你又安全了！

raw_source: Nnf... might need a little help standing.
translation: 唔……可能得扶我一把才能站起来。

raw_source: That beating you dished out was one thing... but that's not all...
translation: 你把我揍成这样是一回事……但还不止如此……

raw_source: I was under the control of... a queen. Dark and cruel.
translation: 我之前被……一位女王控制着。她阴暗又残忍。

raw_source: Feels like she sapped most of the energy I had left, when her will left me.
translation: 感觉她的意志离开我时，把我剩下的大半力气也抽走了。

raw_source: I might not be able to swing a tazer for a while... but here, take this.
translation: 我可能有一阵子挥不动电击枪了……不过，来，拿着这个。

raw_source: It's dad's old whistle. You gave it to me for my first mission, remember...?
translation: 这是爸爸的旧哨子。我第一次出任务时，你把它给了我，还记得吗……？

raw_source: I'll pilot your ship, and wherever you blow the whistle, I'll pick you up!
translation: 我来驾驶你的飞船，不管你在哪儿吹响哨子，我都会去接你！

raw_source: That's the least I can do for saving me, right...?

raw_source: I'm not gonna fight anymore! Come back here!!
translation: 我不会再动手了！回来啊！！

raw_source: You're the only lead I have and... oh darn it!
translation: 你可是我唯一的线索，而且……哦，真可恶！

raw_source: Wah! There we go!
translation: 哈！搞定啦！

raw_source: Could probably have taken you out in one smack if they gave me a better tazer
translation: 要是给我把好点的电击枪，我大概一击就能放倒你

raw_source: instead of this weak little trainee gear.
translation: 而不是这套弱得可怜的实习装备。

raw_source: They were worried that I might hurt myself or get my gear stolen. Yeah right!
translation: 他们怕我伤到自己，或被抢走装备。真会瞎操心！

raw_source: ...wait...
As if I haven't already spent years studying up on all the safety protocols
translation: 说得好像我没花好几年钻研那些安全规程似的

raw_source: nevermind all the various ways to safely study all sorts of creatures.
translation: 更别说安全研究各种生物的种种方法了。

raw_source: But nope, even a prodigy like me has to start off with a weakened lighttazer.
translation: 可偏不行，连我这样的天才也得先用弱化版光电击枪。

raw_source: But with all this roughhousing out of the way, how about we call a truce?
translation: 不过既然已经打闹够了，不如我们休战吧？

raw_source: I'm down here to figure out what's keeping fellas like you from thriving
translation: 我来这下面，就是要查清是什么让你们这样的家伙无法兴旺生存，

raw_source: so I know we'll work it out!
translation: 所以我知道，我们一定能解决的！

raw_source: Yes, Cosmobreeders...
translation: 没错，宇宙育种者……

raw_source: Trained in intergalactic standards of fauna management...
translation: 受过星际动物管理标准的专业训练……

raw_source: With our skills, we can turn around any planet, even a wasteland...
translation: 凭我们的本事，任何星球，哪怕是荒原，都能重获生机……

raw_source: Once we let our presence be known, on any planet of the galaxy...
translation: 只要我们在银河中的任何星球亮明身份……

raw_source: ...creatures just open up their hearts and souls to us!
translation: ……生物们就会向我们敞开心扉、坦诚相待！

raw_source: And with the combined efforts of all of us together, this planet will-
translation: 而只要我们大家齐心协力，这颗星球就会——

raw_source: H-hey! Come on now!
translation: 喂、喂！别这样嘛！

raw_source: I told you! We were on a truce now!
translation: 我说过了！我们现在已经休战了！

raw_source: O-oh, your poor head... And that poor door...!
translation: 噢、噢，你可怜的脑袋……还有那扇可怜的门……！

raw_source: You know, I was hoping to leave back the way I came...
translation: 我本来还想从原路回去呢……

raw_source: But now I just gotta hope that the ceiling doesn't...
translation: 现在只能盼着天花板别……

raw_source: ...do that!
translation: ……真那么干了！

raw_source: First my gear stolen, and now a ceiling collapsing on top of me?
translation: 先是装备被偷，现在连天花板都塌下来砸我？

raw_source: Can't I get ANY lucky breaks down here???
translation: 在这鬼地方，我就不能走一回运吗？？？

raw_source: ...wait a sec, what's that falling from up there...?
translation: ……等下，上头掉下来的是什么……？

raw_source: No way... it can't be!
translation: 不会吧……不可能！

raw_source: Oh, awesome! Now THIS is a lucky break!
translation: 噢，太棒了！这下真走运了！

raw_source: It's not every day that a hyper bracer falls into your lap!
translation: 超能护腕可不是天天都能捡到的！

raw_source: With this I'll be able to hyper slide my way out of here in a jiffy!
translation: 有了它，我就能靠超能滑行一溜烟冲出去了！

raw_source: Let's do this!
translation: 来吧！

raw_source: Heh! Heh! Heh!
translation: 嘿！嘿！嘿！

raw_source: Some of you little folks have some proper fight in you... Heh!
translation: 你们这帮小个子里，还真有几个能打的……嘿！

raw_source: I'd almost thought that the lot of you were merely an annoyance
translation: 我还差点以为，你们这群家伙只会惹人烦

raw_source: but here's one that actually manged to hit me. Heh!
translation: 没想到还真有一个打中我了。呵！

raw_source: What's next, one of you coming along and knocking me down to-
translation: 接下来呢，你们还想来一个把我也撞——

raw_source: Come on, I beat you fair and square! Stop trying to act cool.
translation: 得了，我可是堂堂正正打赢你的！别装酷了。

raw_source: You know I'm a better fighter, and I accept your defeat.
translation: 你知道我身手更强，我也接受你的认输。

raw_source: No more harm will come to you so long as you tell me whe-
translation: 不会再伤你，只要告诉我在—

raw_source: W-what?? How did you get behind me so fast???
translation: 什、什么？？你怎么一下就到我背后了？？？

raw_source: Harm? My little yellow furred companion? You wish to tell me of harm?
translation: 伤害？黄毛小朋友，你要跟我谈伤害？

raw_source: Perhaps you'd like a lesson in just such a topic as "harm"
translation: 也许你想亲自上一堂关于“伤害”的课

raw_source: and then you can recite it to me, no?
translation: 然后再背给我听，如何？

raw_source: Y-yeah... I can... I can tell you a lot about harm... now.... oow....
translation: 是、是啊……现在……伤害这事，我懂得可多了……嗷……

raw_source: ...j-just lemme get my breath back...
translation: ……就、就让我喘口气……

raw_source: Here, spunky yellow boy. Take your leave of my domain.
translation: 好吧，有股冲劲的黄毛小子，离开我的领地吧。

raw_source: And while you're at it, take this garbage that a fellow small fighter left
translation: 顺便，把另一个小个子战士留下的垃圾带走

raw_source: after I had given him an even rougher lesson than yours.
translation: 我当时给他的教训，可比给你的还要狠。

raw_source: With shoes in hand, Yiffai scrambles out as the Redbull drops deeper into the mines
translation: 伊法伊拿着靴子爬出去，红牛则深入矿井

raw_source: his glowing red mane fading eerily into the dark...
translation: 他泛着红光的鬃毛诡异地隐入黑暗……

raw_source: Woah, you really took a beating, lady!
translation: 哇，你可真是挨了好一顿揍啊，女士！

raw_source: But you look just as fresh as you did when I first entered here...
translation: 可你看起来还是跟我刚进来时一样精神……

raw_source: You're really one of those immortal elves, ain't ya?
translation: 你真的是那些不朽精灵中的一员，对吧？

raw_source: Correct, my young sir. I am Enelye, the Immortal High Lady of the Tutone Elves.
translation: 没错，年轻的先生。我是恩内莉，图托恩精灵的不朽至高女领主。

raw_source: I must commend your most respectable performance in the art of combat
translation: 你在战斗技艺上的表现令人肃然起敬，我必须予以赞扬，

raw_source: it was a highly enjoyable act to watch, even for one as old as I.
translation: 即便对我这样年长的人而言，观赏这场表演也十分愉快。

raw_source: It was so enjoyable, that I believe you are due for a reward.
translation: 实在是太令人愉快了，我想你理应得到一份奖励。

raw_source: So please, sit back and relax while I...
translation: 所以，请坐好，放松下来，让我……

raw_source: ...reward... you suitably...
translation: ……好好地……奖励你……

raw_source: H-hey! Come on lady! You gotta be making some mistake!
translation: 喂、喂！拜托，女士！你肯定是弄错什么了！

raw_source: Aaaaa!
translation: 啊啊啊！

raw_source: ...w-wait! No! Don't do that!
translation: ……等、等等！不！别这样！

raw_source: ...n-no no no! I'm a boy! I don't wear these sorts of... dresses!
translation: ……不、不不不！我是男孩！我不穿这种……裙子！

raw_source: N-not that there's anything wrong with boys in dresses... but... b-but...!
translation: 倒、倒不是说男孩穿裙子有什么不对……可是……可、可是……！

raw_source: Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.
translation: 汝虽未经锤炼，这一战却也打得不差。
symbol_source: Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.

raw_source: Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.
translation: 敢问阁下尊姓大名，好让吾致以敬意。
symbol_source: Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.

raw_source: ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...
translation: ……啊，然而汝故土之民，并不通晓吾之言语……
symbol_source: ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...

raw_source: W-what? No matter how much I fight... There's just no winning!
translation: 什、什么？再怎么打……都赢不了！

raw_source: Who are you? W-what are you doing down here?
translation: 你是谁？你、你在下面做什么？

raw_source: I need not speaketh your crude tongue in order to understand your crude desire
translation: 无需说汝那粗鄙之语，吾亦明了汝粗鄙之欲
symbol_source: I need not speaketh your crude tongue in order to understand your crude desire

raw_source: So struggle not as I placeth a most useful trinket upon thee.
translation: 莫要挣扎，且让吾为汝戴上这实用的小饰物。
symbol_source: So struggle not as I placeth a most useful trinket upon thee.

raw_source: H-hey! What the hell is this? I'm not some darn pet of yours to collar!
translation: 喂、喂！搞什么鬼？我又不是你家宠物，戴什么项圈！

raw_source: I'll find a way to bring you down, just give me a minute and I'll-
translation: 我会想办法打倒你的，给我一分钟，我就——

raw_source: And thou shall do what, fairest knight?
translation: 那么，俊美的骑士，汝又待如何？

raw_source: Mine powers are ancient and forgotten, and thou are but a pup lost in the dark.
translation: 吾之力量古老而被世人遗忘，汝不过是迷失黑暗的小犬。

raw_source: Prayeth that I overlook your ill mannered outburst, as the generous host I am.
translation: 祈求吾这位宽宏的主人，不计较汝方才的无礼罢。

raw_source: Now taketh this necklace so that you may understand others of this land
translation: 且收下这项链，好让汝听懂此地众人的话语

raw_source: ...and spareth them from your ill manners...eh heh heh heh...
translation: ……也省得旁人再领教汝的无礼……呵呵呵呵……

raw_source: And with a gutteral laugh, the demonic form faded back into the darkest darks
translation: 伴着喉间一阵低笑，那魔影退回了最深的黑暗

raw_source: leaving nought but a scared pup in his wake...
translation: 只留下一个吓坏了的小狗崽……

raw_source: Now WHY did you have to go and do that, huh?
translation: 现在，你干嘛非得去干那种事，嗯？

raw_source: One of you sorts went and ransacked all my belongings right after I landed
translation: 我前脚刚落地，你们这种家伙就后脚把我所有家当翻了个精光

raw_source: and now you're trying to take me down in one-on-one combat?
translation: 如今你却想在一对一单挑里把我打倒？

raw_source: No chance! I've just about had enough of you little bra-
translation: 没门！我真是受够了你们这些小混-

raw_source: -hey...
Is that... No way...
translation: 那是……不可能吧……

raw_source: ...but YES way!
translation: ……可偏偏就是！

raw_source: It's my Cosmohelm! It got all the way over here somehow!
translation: 是我的Cosmohelm！它不知怎么一路跑到这边来了！

raw_source: This'll be real good to have in case I ever have to go into space or something!
translation: 万一哪天我得上太空什么的，这玩意儿可就派上大用场了！

raw_source: Just need to keep an eye out for the Cosmosuit portion...
translation: 只要再留心Cosmosuit那一部分就好...

raw_source: ...and I'll be able to have a nice proper airtight outfit! Hoorah!
translation: ……我就能有一套像样的密封好装备啦！好耶！

raw_source: D-darn it! Come on Yiffany, don't you remember me?
translation: 可、可恶！拜托啊，伊法妮，你不记得我了吗？

raw_source: It's me! Your little brother! Darn it!!!
translation: 是我啊！你的弟弟！可恶！！！

raw_source: Nnngh... d-don't worry, lil bro, I remember you...
translation: 唔……别、别担心，弟弟，我记得你……

raw_source: But give me another concussion and I can't say I'll keep on remembering you
translation: 不过你要是再把我打出一次脑震荡，我可不敢保证还能记得你

raw_source: so maybe give me a moment, eh?
translation: 所以让我缓一会儿，行吗？

raw_source: Let me have at least... 5 seconds to clear my head before you swing...
translation: 你再动手之前，至少给我……5秒钟清醒一下脑子……

raw_source: and then I'll be able to throw you to the ground like old times, alright?
translation: 然后我就能像以前一样把你摔在地上了，好吧？

raw_source: You're back! Yiffany! Sister!
translation: 你回来了！伊法妮！姐姐！

raw_source: All it took was 3 rounds of repeated blows to your head...
translation: 只不过是朝你脑袋反复打了3轮……

raw_source: ...but now you're back!
translation: ……不过现在你回来了！

raw_source: Help me up lil bro, it's not just my head that took the whacking all this time.
translation: 扶我起来，弟弟，这么一通打下来，挨揍的可不只是我的脑袋。

raw_source: I was under control of... a dark queen.
translation: 我之前被……一位黑暗女王控制着。

raw_source: I feel as if all my energy has been sapped out, now that I'm free from them.
translation: 如今摆脱了控制，我感觉全身的力气都像被抽干了。

raw_source: Don't think I'm fit for combat anymore, but here: take this.
translation: 我想我现在不适合再战斗了，不过，来，拿着这个。

raw_source: It's the whistle dad gave me when I first started to follow in his footsteps!
translation: 这是我刚开始追随爸爸的脚步时，他给我的哨子！

raw_source: Blow it practically anywhere and I'll be able to pick you up in your ship.
translation: 几乎不管在哪儿吹响它，我都能开着你的飞船来接你。

raw_source: If nothing else, I can be your pilot while you play at hero this time, okay?
translation: 别的不说，这次你逞英雄的时候，我至少还能当你的飞行员，好吗？

raw_source: Wham! Wa-chow! Ka-POW!!!
translation: 砰！嘿咻！看——招！！！

raw_source: How'd ya like THOSE moves, buddy? Can't just launch yourself at a Cosmobreeder
translation: 伙计，这几招滋味如何？可不能对宇宙育种者扑过来，

raw_source: and not end up on the receiving end of the PPP's renowned combat lessons!
translation: 却不领教一下PPP久负盛名的格斗课程！

raw_source: Good thing you stopped when you did. One more counter from me and yo-
translation: 幸好你及时停手了。我要再反击一次，你就——

raw_source: ["Counter", my friend? Surely you jest.]
translation: [“反击”，我的朋友？你一定是在说笑。]

raw_source: [As a father, I have much experience in play-fighting with pups such as yourself.]
translation: [身为父亲，我可没少陪你这样的小崽子打闹。]

raw_source: [My true powers are far beyond anything you can comprehend!]
translation: [我真正的力量，远远超出你的理解！]

raw_source: [...but for now, you may experience a mere taste of my PSY powers!!!]
translation: [……不过现在，你可以先尝尝我精神力量的一点皮毛！！！]

raw_source: ...bark?
[Bark indeed, my little friend.]
translation: [没错，就是汪，我的小朋友。]

raw_source: [Now, perhaps in order to get you accustomed to this new PSY-forced form]
translation: [现在，为了让你适应这个被精神力强制变成的新形态，]

raw_source: [you can demonstrate some of these amazing "counters" that you believe you have?]
translation: [不如展示一下你自以为会的那些精彩“反击”？]

raw_source: G-good to be back to my old self now but...
translation: 变、变回原来的自己真好，不过……

raw_source: ...yeah, t-that old dog can really fight... ouch...
translation: ……是啊，那、那条老狗可真能打……疼……

raw_source: ...time to find me some Vitamins...
translation: ……该找点维生素了……

raw_source: ...or a place to fall asleep... ow...
translation: ……或者找个地方睡一觉……疼……

raw_source: ...gee Dad, did you have to be so rough on that guy?
translation: ……哎，爸爸，你非得对那个家伙下这么重的手吗？

raw_source: I've never seen you fight with someone like that before!
translation: 我以前从没见过你那样跟谁打过！

raw_source: My son, that "guy" was able to accept and master our ESPer powers
translation: 儿子，那个“家伙”竟能接受并掌握我们超能力者的力量，

raw_source: in the span of a single battle.
translation: 只用了一场战斗的时间。

raw_source: He very well may be the one to save this world from the sorry state it's in.
translation: 他很可能就是能把这个世界从困境中拯救出来的人。

raw_source: Wow, Dad! I thought you didn't believe in the rumors of "Cosmobreeder" heroes!
translation: 哇，爸爸！我还以为你不相信“宇宙育种者”英雄的传闻呢！

raw_source: ...this one is different, son. They may indeed be a true hero...
translation: ……这一个不一样，儿子。这位或许真的是英雄……

raw_source: Awww, look at you! You're adorable! And small!
translation: 哎呀，瞧瞧你！真可爱！还这么小！

raw_source: What made you decide to start roughhousing with me, lil guy?
translation: 小家伙，你怎么会想来跟我打闹呢？

raw_source: You're lucky that it was only me that you started tussling with
translation: 算你走运，你惹上的只是我，

raw_source: and not any of the more vicious creatures down here!
translation: 而不是这下面那些更凶狠的生物！

raw_source: Some of them are pretty nasty, you know?
translation: 有些家伙可相当凶，你知道吗？

raw_source: Awww but you don't know what I'm going on about, do you?
translation: 哎呀，不过你听不懂我在说什么，对吧？

raw_source: A cute little guy like you just wants to run and jump around...
translation: 你这么可爱的小家伙，就该四处跑跑跳跳……

raw_source: ...and that's what you should be allowed to do!
translation: ……而你就应该能自由自在地这么做！

raw_source: Go on lil guy! Have more fun out there!
translation: 去吧，小家伙！到外面多玩玩！

raw_source: Your big ol' uncle Yiffai will be around if you get into trouble
translation: 要是碰上麻烦，你的伊法伊大叔就在附近，

raw_source: so don't hesitate to bark out for help! I'll come a'runnin.
translation: 尽管汪汪叫着求救！我会跑过来的。

raw_source: O-oh hey! That's some pretty mighty digging you're doing...
translation: 哦、哦嘿！你挖得可真起劲……

raw_source: Did you forget a bone or maybe a ball or something...
translation: 你是不是忘了骨头，或者球之类的什么东西……

raw_source: Or... or...
translation: 还是……还是……

raw_source: ...or is that a Level 1 Keycard? And you're giving it to me!?
translation: ……还是说，那是张1级门卡？而你要把它送给我！？

raw_source: Well heck! Ain't you just the best little nephew Uncle Yiffai could want?
translation: 哎呀！伊法伊大叔哪还能找到比你更棒的小侄子？

raw_source: Thanks pupperoo, I won't forget it!
translation: 谢谢你，小狗崽，我不会忘记的！

raw_source: What? Trying to spirit away again?
translation: 什么？又想溜走？

raw_source: Come on! There's no way you're getting away like that!
translation: 少来！你休想就这么逃走！

raw_source: Hang on lil bro, I'm about to show you some real flying!
translation: 抓紧了，弟弟，马上让你见识什么才叫真正的驾驶技术！

raw_source: Watch me put this baby into overdrive, and then I'll-
translation: 看我让这宝贝全速运转，然后我就——

raw_source: ...this baby is having... problems!
translation: ……这宝贝出了点……问题！

raw_source: No!!!! She got away!!!
translation: 不！！！！她逃走了！！！

raw_source: There's no way to catch up to her now, she's out of sight completely!
translation: 现在根本追不上她了，已经完全看不见她了！

raw_source: Darn it all!! If only this ship was fully repaired with all its parts!
translation: 真是可恶！！要是这艘飞船的零件都配齐、彻底修好了就好了！

raw_source: ...I guess there's nothing else we can do, baby bro.
translation: ……我想我们也没别的办法了，小弟。

raw_source: Just have to hope that Traeh doesn't manage to get her energy back...
translation: 只能希望特蕾没法恢复她的能量了……

raw_source: ...and hope that the galaxy is safe...
translation: ……也希望银河系平安无事……

raw_source: Nooo! Curse you damn Yiffai siblings!
translation: 不要啊！诅咒你们，该死的伊法伊姐弟！

raw_source: I was supposed to rule the world... no... the Galaxy!
translation: 我本该统治世界的……不……是整个银河！

raw_source: And now... now...!
translation: 而现在……现在……！

translation: 哇，姐姐，我们刚才真的……救了整整一颗星球？

raw_source: Buuut pretty impressive for my baby bro's first real mission, so good going!
translation: 不——过嘛，对我家小弟的第一次真正任务来说已经相当厉害了，干得漂亮！

raw_source: The heroes of Tutone! They return!
translation: 图托恩的英雄们！他们回来了！

raw_source: Traeh has been defeated, her psychic disturbances are no more and her minions flee!
translation: 特蕾已被击败，她的灵能扰动不复存在，她的手下四散逃窜！

raw_source: Cheers for the heroes!
translation: 为英雄们欢呼！

raw_source: YIP! YIP! HOORAY!

raw_source: YIP! YIP! HOORAY!
translation: YIP！YIP！好耶！

raw_source: BLESSED BE THE COSMOBREEDERS, SAVIORS OF OUR PLANET!
translation: 愿宇宙育种者受颂，我们星球的救星！

raw_source: Wow, good going you two! Clearing out a whole planet of baddies...
translation: 哇，你们俩真棒！把整颗星球的坏蛋都清理干净了……

raw_source: That's definitely gonna help the local fauna get back on track!
translation: 这肯定能帮当地的动物们重回正轨！

raw_source: I knew you two could do it. Never had a doubt in my mind.
translation: 我就知道你们俩能做到。我心里从没怀疑过。

raw_source: Not even when one of you went AWOL and stopped responding to all communica-
translation: 就连你们中有人擅离职守、不再回应任何通——

raw_source: -Ahem...
translation: -嗯哼……

raw_source: This will definitely be a good report to have filed away, Agents!
translation: 这份报告绝对值得归档留存，特工们！

raw_source: Nice one, grrrrl! You and your pup brother really cleaned up down there!
translation: 干得漂亮，grrrrl！你和你的小狗弟弟在下面真把坏蛋都清理光了！

raw_source: Just don't forget about us at HQ when all the fame goes to your heads, alright?
translation: 只是等名气让你们忘乎所以的时候，可别忘了还在总部的我们，好吗？

raw_source: HOORAH FOR YIFFANY AND YIFFAI! STAR COSMOBREEDERS!
translation: 为伊法妮和伊法伊欢呼！明星级宇宙育种者！

raw_source: H O O R A Y ! ! !
translation: 好 耶 ！ ！ ！

raw_source: Heh, how about that, sis? We made a pretty good team, didn't we?
translation: 嘿，瞧见没，姐姐？我们配合得挺不错，不是吗？

raw_source: Wellll... you did alright, bro.
translation: 嗯——……你还行啦，老弟。

raw_source: ...for a pup.
translation: ……就一只小崽子而言。

raw_source: [SO ENDS THE REPORT ON PLANET TUTONE.]
translation: [图托恩星球的报告至此结束。]

raw_source: [A PLANET WITH A TUMULTUOUS HISTORY, FACING THE GREATEST CHALLENGES OF ITS TIME]
translation: [一颗历史动荡、正面临其时代最严峻挑战的星球]

raw_source: [SAVED BY THE VALIANT EFFORTS OF TWO BRAVE COSMOBREEDERS:]
translation: [因两位勇敢的宇宙育种者的英勇努力而获救：]

raw_source: [YIFFANY YIFFAI, ELDER SISTER AND SEASONED VETERAN WITH UNMATCHED COMBAT SKILL]
translation: [伊法妮·伊法伊，姐姐，久经沙场的老兵，拥有无与伦比的战斗技巧]

raw_source: [AND YIFFAI YIFFAI, THE YOUNGER BROTHER PRODIGY WITH UNENDING ENTHUSIASM]
translation: [以及伊法伊·伊法伊，热情永不枯竭的天才弟弟]

raw_source: [WITH THE TWO OF THEM TEAMED UP, THERE'S NO MISSION THAT THEY CAN'T HANDLE]
translation: [两人联手，没有他们应付不了的任务]

raw_source: What? Trying to spirit away again?
translation: 什么？又想溜走？

raw_source: Come on! There's no way you're getting away like that!
translation: 少来！你休想就这么逃走！

raw_source: Hang on lil bro, I'm about to show you some real flying!
translation: 抓紧了，弟弟，马上让你见识什么才叫真正的驾驶技术！

raw_source: Here we go! Full turbo! This ship is fully locked and fully loaded!
translation: 来了！涡轮全开！这艘飞船武器就绪，弹药满载！

raw_source: Now let's take down this wannabe queen for real!
translation: 现在就来彻底打倒这个妄称女王的家伙！

raw_source: Here we go!!!
translation: 出发啦！！！

raw_source: [STARDATE XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [PLANET TUTONE, 5555 SYSTEM] [MAGNETOSHEATH ENTRY POINT]
translation: [星历XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [5555星系，图托恩星] [磁鞘进入点]

raw_source: ...entry successful, en route to descend at 40N, 74W in T-minus XXXX unisecs.
translation: ……成功进入，正前往40N、74W下降点，距下降还有XXXX标准秒。

raw_source: Engine temp stable at 2640 degrees, plasma, oxygen and battery levels good.
translation: 引擎温度稳定在2640度，等离子、氧气和电量正常。

raw_source: This is Cosmobreeder Yiffai, requesting mission update from CO Bossu, over!
translation: 这里是宇宙育种者伊法伊，请求Bossu指挥官更新任务情报，完毕！

raw_source: Now listen up here agent Yiffai, you may have graduated top of your class
translation: 听好了，伊法伊特工，你虽然以全班第一毕业，

raw_source: but we wouldn't have sent you on this mission if we had any other choice.
translation: 但凡还有别的选择，我们都不会派你执行这次任务。

raw_source: Oh come on, still worried because this is my first mission? I'll be on my toes!
translation: 拜托，还因为这是我第一次出任务而担心？我会保持警惕的！

raw_source: Especially if my sister was among the agents that disappeared mid-mission.
translation: 尤其姐姐可能就在那些任务中失踪的特工里。

raw_source: That's right, we can't be too careful. You're the only capable agent we had left.
translation: 没错，再谨慎也不为过。你是我们仅剩的能干特工了。

raw_source: Just remember, Tutone is having a mass exodus of fauna
translation: 记住，图托恩正在发生动物大规模外逃，

raw_source: and your job is to find out why!
translation: 你的任务就是查明原因！

raw_source: On top of that, you should also look for your missing fellow agents.
translation: 除此之外，你还得寻找失踪的特工同伴。

raw_source: Just make...sur...ou...on your...oes...or....
translation: 只要确……保……你……多加……小……心……

raw_source: Oh? What's this? Another little spacebug entering my domain?
translation: 哦？这是什么？又一只小太空虫闯进了我的领地？

raw_source: Enjoy your crash landing like your other little interlopers did, puppy!
translation: 小狗，跟其他小入侵者一样，好好享受坠机吧！

raw_source: Who the heck are you calling a pup?!?
translation: 你到底叫谁小狗呢？！？

raw_source: And how the heck did these ships sneak up on me?
translation: 还有，这些船到底怎么偷偷摸到我身边的？

raw_source: Gah! There's too many of them! I need to make an emergency landing!
translation: 啊！敌人太多了！我得紧急迫降！

raw_source: Commander! If you can hear me, I can't wait for permission, sorry!
translation: 指挥官！如果你听得见，抱歉，我等不及批准了！

raw_source: Geeeeeze, those buggy buggers did a number on my paint job!
translation: 天啊啊，那帮臭虫把我的涂装毁惨了！

raw_source: Don't they know that repairs and touch ups come out of my paycheck? The jerks...
translation: 她们难道不知道维修和翻新都得从我的工资里扣？混蛋……

raw_source: Post orbital thrusters are hecked up, but this jalopy of mine should still fly.
translation: 后轨道推进器坏了，不过我这老破船应该还能飞。

raw_source: Just need to get into this sneaking suit now that I'm terra bound, and...
translation: 既然落地了，先穿上这身潜行服，然后……

raw_source: What in the whatwhat!!
translation: 这都什么跟什么啊！！

raw_source: Who the heck are you!?! And what are you doing with my gear!?!
translation: 你到底是谁？！？拿我的装备干什么？！？

raw_source: That little punk just took my stuff and jumped down this hole!
translation: 那个小混蛋抢了我的东西，跳进这个洞了！

raw_source: ...now that I think about it, though...
translation: ……不过，现在仔细想想……

raw_source: ...I don't really remember where I was supposed to start my search...
translation: ……我不太记得该从哪里开始搜寻了……

raw_source: ...and it's starting to storm!
translation: ……还开始刮暴风雨了！

raw_source: Alright! No time to worry about it! Just gotta go for it!
translation: 好！没空发愁了！直接上就是！

raw_source: The local fauna and the safety of my fellow agents is depending on me!
translation: 当地动物和特工同伴的安危，都指望我了！
